in_sanskrit.name: Alpesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Friend, protector
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Alpesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Alpesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Alp', which means friend or protector. This name is often given to boys in Hindu communities as a symbol of their role as a guardian and companion.
